envelope.description: Add membership indexes and atomic schema6 backfill

body.title: Add membership indexes and atomic schema6 backfill
body.summary: Add file/repo dupsort handles and binary/digest keys; verify named DB capacity. Backfill authoritative v5 rows atomically with registry validation, rollback/retry and version stamping only on success. Update current-version assertions; retain historical fixtures. Use genuine raw v5 fixtures and fail after partial membership insertion.
acceptanceChecks: Fresh/populated v5 migration yields exact memberships without reindex.
Partial migration failure rolls back data/version and retries on reopen.
Reopen is idempotent and unsupported-version refusal remains.

tests.name: File/repository index key encoding and long Unicode path support
Schema-v5 backfill, rollback after partial writes, retry and reopen idempotence
